notes.title: Astral Outcast Demo Hotfix
notes.notes:
[p]Quick Hotfix for the demo.

✨ Improvements:[/p][p]
- Popups are now grouped.[/p][p]- Icebox on ship now only accepts ice.[/p][p]- All Containers are now categorized: Resources, Food, Clothes, etc.[/p][p]- Inventory items can now be transfered with SHIFT-LMB.[/p][p]- You can now drag items from and to containers.[/p][p][/p][p] 🔧 Fixes:[/p][p]
- Fixed a quest progression issue with ship planters.[/p][p]- Added a Cancel button for the amount slider.   [/p]
